title: Verified receipt store lacks TTL and per-peer isolation
description: Security review: verified receipts use only a global 128-entry FIFO. A receipt remains security-elevatable indefinitely until unrelated traffic evicts it, and one authenticated peer can churn every other peer's pending timing/ACK receipts. Add trusted-monotonic TTL and per-peer/purpose/session quotas or immediate dispatch consumption; test exact expiry and cross-peer flood isolation.
